IN PHOTOS │Anti-riot police personnel conduct drills and practice their formations in preparation for potential civil disturbances or protests, at the Manila Police District Headquarters in Ermita, Manila, on November 13, 2025. According to the National Capital Region Police Office, more than 16,400 officers will be deployed to secure the three-day Iglesia ni Cristo rally at Quirino Grandstand in Manila from November 16 to 18.
